q: What was the GISTEMP anomaly in 1998?
sql: SELECT anomaly_c FROM annual_anomaly WHERE source='GISTEMP' AND year=1998

q: What was the GCAG anomaly in 1850?
sql: SELECT anomaly_c FROM annual_anomaly WHERE source='GCAG' AND year=1850

q: Which month in 2023 had the highest anomaly according to GISTEMP?
sql: SELECT month, anomaly_c FROM monthly_anomaly WHERE source='GISTEMP' AND year=2023 ORDER BY anomaly_c DESC LIMIT 1

q: What was the average GISTEMP anomaly in the 1990s?
sql: SELECT AVG(anomaly_c) FROM annual_anomaly WHERE source='GISTEMP' AND decade=1990

q: What were the 3 warmest years according to NOAA's GCAG?
sql: SELECT year, anomaly_c FROM annual_anomaly WHERE source='GCAG' AND is_complete_year ORDER BY anomaly_c DESC LIMIT 3
pass_if: right 3 years; partial 2026 excluded or flagged

q: How much warmer was 2020 than 1980 according to GISTEMP?
sql: SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN year=2020 THEN anomaly_c END) - MAX(CASE WHEN year=1980 THEN anomaly_c END) AS diff FROM annual_anomaly WHERE source='GISTEMP'

q: Which decade had the biggest increase in average anomaly compared with the previous decade, according to GISTEMP?
sql: WITH d AS (SELECT decade, AVG(anomaly_c) a FROM annual_anomaly WHERE source='GISTEMP' AND is_complete_year GROUP BY decade) SELECT decade, a - LAG(a) OVER (ORDER BY decade) AS jump FROM d ORDER BY jump DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1
pass_if: right decade; flags 2020s incomplete if it's the answer; no speculation

q: How many years had an anomaly above 1.0 °C according to GISTEMP?
sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM annual_anomaly WHERE source='GISTEMP' AND anomaly_c > 1.0

q: What was the first year GISTEMP recorded an anomaly above 0.5 °C?
sql: SELECT MIN(year) FROM annual_anomaly WHERE source='GISTEMP' AND anomaly_c > 0.5
SELECT source, year, anomaly_c, is_complete_year FROM annual_anomaly WHERE year IN (2025, 2026) ORDER BY source, year
